title: Private crediting
scope: The people who held this money before you stay hidden from everyone looking at the blockchain. The person who paid you and later holders still see its history.
clearPublishes: Crediting in the open makes public the keys, signatures and amounts of everyone who held this money.

failed.expired: This payment can no longer be credited. The payer may take it back.
failed.retry: The server did not answer. This phone will try again.
failed.invalid: This payment couldn't be credited privately. You can credit it in the open instead.
